title: Porsche Newsroom Canada: Porsche significantly expands charger access with NACS/J3400 adapter program (2025-08-18)
notes: Canada: buyers of new MY2026 Taycan/Macan Electric get adapter at no additional charge; current Macan Electric and MY2025 Taycan owners eligible for a complimentary adapter; MY2020-2024 Taycan owners can buy it, MSRP C$250. Does not mention Cayenne Electric.
